notes: Historical recorded telemetry, not live. Absolute log times, row order, duplicates and irregular spacing preserved.
CLT and IAT units are blank in CSV; °F inferred from project display context and readings, not encoded in CSV. Duty Cycle unit is blank in CSV; percent inferred from channel meaning.
Oil Pressure is logged PSI, not raw OilPressure; physical sensor calibration is unverified.
AFR and target are recorded O2 channels. Sensor readiness and exhaust delay are not established by elapsed time; do not use this replay to tune fuel.
Speed channel exists in CSV but is not verified as a usable vehicle-speed signal; speed, fuel and oil temperature are null. Sync is the raw status code, not interpreted.
